p.challenge: Arrange the steps of Desai's argument

nodes.text: Desai sets tests for a welfare state
nodes.info: Freedom from poverty, discrimination and insecurity; less income inequality; community needs before profit; stable development; jobs for all.

nodes.text: Apply them to Britain and the USA
nodes.info: Advanced capitalist countries.

nodes.text: Poverty, inequality and joblessness persist
nodes.info: Booms and busts also continue: they fail many tests.

nodes.text: Conclusion: the welfare state is largely a myth
nodes.info: Under capitalism it does not deliver.

nodes.text: Communist states also criticised
nodes.info: They did not adequately protect democracy and freedoms.
